attchmntText: RHI MAGNESITA INDIA LTD has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release".
voiceSummary: RHI Magnesita India Limited reported unaudited consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. Revenue from operations was 1,030 crore, representing a 0.5% year-on-year decline. EBITDA stood at 144 crore, a 30% increase year-on-year, with an EBITDA margin of 14%. Profit after tax reached 62 crore, marking a 62% year-on-year surge. Net cash to EBITDA ratio was 0.25x, and shipment volumes totaled 118 KT. The company also announced the appointment of Abhishek Bajaj as Chief Financial Officer and Chief Investor Relations Officer, effective 1st January 2027. He succeeds Azim Syed, who is transitioning to a senior global leadership role within the RHI Magnesita Group in Vienna.

attchmntText: RHI MAGNESITA INDIA LTD has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Financial Results for quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026
voiceSummary: RHI Magnesita India Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. Statutory auditors BSR & Co. LLP issued limited review reports on these results. The Board accepted the resignation of Mr. Azim Syed as Chief Financial Officer and Chief Investor Relations Officer, effective 31 December 2026. Mr. Abhishek Bajaj was appointed to these positions with effect from 1 January 2027. Mr. Syed will cease to be Key Managerial Personnel on 31 December 2026. Mr. Bajaj will become Key Managerial Personnel on 1 January 2027. The revised list of Key Managerial Personnel includes Mr. Pankaj Malhan as Managing Director and CEO, Mr. Abhishek Bajaj as Chief Financial Officer, and Mr. Sanjay Kumar as Company Secretary. The Board meeting was held on 13 November 2026.
